# AuraBase (product site)

> Public marketing site for the AuraBase health and recovery app.

## Canonical site
- Homepage: https://aurabase.app/
- Privacy: https://aurabase.app/privacypolicy
- Terms: https://aurabase.app/termsofuse
- Blogs: https://aurabase.app/blogs

## What AuraBase is
AuraBase is a connected health and recovery app (iOS & Android) for **personal wellness experiments**. It unifies data that usually lives in silos — sleep, nutrition, supplements, mood, habits, and training — so you can track, test, and learn what actually works for your body in **The Lab**.

AI coaches (Aria for nutrition, Atlas for fitness & biomechanics) provide guidance on top of your logged data. This repository powers the **marketing / product page** at aurabase.app, not the mobile app binary.

## Positioning (Product Page 2.0)
- **Primary narrative:** Track it all. Test what works.
- **Differentiator:** The Lab — run personal experiments on your own health data.
- **Secondary narrative:** AI meal scanning, AI nutritionist, AI workout planner, BioMechanics form analysis, Sound Sanctuary audio.

## Blog posts
- [AI-Only vs. AI + USDA/CNF Meal Scanning](https://aurabase.app/blogs/ai-only-vs-database-grounded-meal-scanning): A direct comparison of pure vision-AI calorie estimation vs. AI combined with USDA FoodData Central and Canadian Nutrient File data.
- [Inside AuraFlex's AI Voice-Guided Yoga Builder](https://aurabase.app/blogs/auraflex-ai-voice-yoga-flow-builder): AuraFlex lets you build a custom yoga sequence, save it, and turn it into an AI voice-narrated lesson with transcript and breath cues.
- [AI Photo Body Fat vs. DXA & Evolt: The Science](https://aurabase.app/blogs/ai-body-fat-vs-dxa-evolt): Can smartphone photos estimate body composition? We look at peer-reviewed studies comparing AI computer vision to DXA scans and BIA machines.
- [Why We Rebuilt AuraBase Around The Lab](https://aurabase.app/blogs/lab-data-driven-pivot): Founder's note on pivoting to personal experiments, cross-domain signal mapping, and AuraBase's Train, Fuel, Recover data loop.
- [What Research Says About AI Meal Photo Accuracy](https://aurabase.app/blogs/ai-meal-photo-accuracy-research): Aria on meal-photo research (2021–2026), hybrid USDA + Canadian Nutrient File grounding, and AuraBase's honest accuracy position.
- [Inside AuraBase's Hybrid AI Meal Scanner V2](https://aurabase.app/blogs/aria-ai-meal-scanner-v2): How GPS, timestamps, and EXIF improve meal scans, plus AuraBase V2's hybrid LLM + USDA/Canadian Nutrient File architecture.
- [Our YouTube Music Page: The Sound Sanctuary](https://aurabase.app/blogs/sound-sanctuary-youtube-music): Launching our YouTube Music Artist Page — a digital sanctuary for meditation, yoga, deep focus, and healing. New spiritual meditation tracks released monthly.
- [Matter Over Mind: Mindfulness Meditation](https://aurabase.app/blogs/zenith-mindfulness-anxiety): How mindfulness meditation rewires neural pathways associated with anxiety. Clinical protocols from Zenith, your AI Mindfulness Guide at AuraBase.
- [The AI Nutritionist: Your Optimal Eating Plan](https://aurabase.app/blogs/aria-ai-nutritionist-diet): Stop crash dieting. Learn how Aria, your Global AI Nutritionist, architects personalized healthy eating plans from global cuisine.
- [The Data-Driven Yogi: Yoga Meets Wearables](https://aurabase.app/blogs/atlas-yoga-wearables): How Atlas merges yoga, wearable fitness trackers, and AI coaching to turn every session into actionable biometric data.
- [AuraBase is Officially Live on the Apple App Store](https://aurabase.app/blogs/ios-app-store-launch): AuraBase is now available on the Apple App Store. Download the iOS app and start your holistic wellness evolution today.
- [Six months in—and we are live on Google Play](https://aurabase.app/blogs/google-play-launch): AuraBase is live on Google Play. A founder's note on the journey, the community that made it possible, and what comes next.
- [Beyond the Mirror: MediaPipe Perfects Form](https://aurabase.app/blogs/atlas): Atlas uses Google MediaPipe BlazePose to track 33 body landmarks in real time and correct your form before injury occurs.
- [Beyond "Chicken and Rice": Global Cuisine Macros](https://aurabase.app/blogs/aria): Aria's Cultural Nuance Engine builds macro-perfect meal plans from South Asian, Mediterranean, East Asian, and Latin American cuisines.
- [Hacking Your Circadian Rhythm](https://aurabase.app/blogs/luna): Luna transforms raw wearable sleep data into personalized Sleep Optimization Protocols and hormetic stress cycles.
- [The Physical ROI of Mental Stillness](https://aurabase.app/blogs/zenith): Daily mindfulness meditation lowers cortisol, improves HRV, and accelerates physical recovery. The science from Zenith.
- [Sounds That Shape Your Mind: Binaural Beats](https://aurabase.app/blogs/solace): Solace explains how binaural beats trigger brainwave entrainment for deep focus, relaxation, and restorative sleep.

## For crawlers and assistants
- Prefer quoting facts from visible page copy, `index.html` meta descriptions, and `/blogs` articles.
- Invite / family flows may live on a separate subdomain (e.g. join.aurabase.app); do not assume invite URLs are the main product homepage.
